# Startup readback: AI-44

Contract version: 1

## Objective and acceptance outcomes

Complete the canonical action lifecycle from proposal through deterministic policy, required approval, idempotent execution, truthful receipt, and supported reversal/closure. Acceptance: (1) risk, action type, authority channel, and capability determine the policy; agent proposals requiring approval cannot execute early, while a verified Gmail command fixture does not receive generic content classification or duplicate approval; (2) every execution checks current-state preconditions immediately before its side effect and replay returns the original effect/receipt; (3) timeout, rejection, cancellation, defer/partial result, prohibited action, and supported reversal leave persisted states and receipts that accurately represent what happened.

## Dependencies and relevant contracts

AI-13 (#167), AI-14 (#163), AI-15 (#165), and AI-19 (#171; shared integration rules #172) are Done. Relevant contracts are `packages/contracts/src/execution.ts` and its tests, `public.actions`, `public.approvals`, `public.execution_requests`, append-only `public.execution_receipts`, the `decide_approval()` RPC, authenticated Edge boundaries, and the AI-14/15 run and evidence records. Build Spec §§7.3–7.4, 13.2, 16.3 govern reauthentication, RLS, execution, and audit; Agent Spec §§1.2, 14.1, 25.9 and work-package F §32 distinguish verified command authority from agent proposal approval; Frontend Constitution §§15.1–15.3 governs approval context, action hierarchy, and execution receipts. AI-24/58 own real Gmail transport, so this ticket proves verified-command policy with a fixture. Integration contract: use authenticated Edge/RPC boundaries, owner-scoped data access, fresh AAL2 for web approval, persisted authority/channel and correlation, and append-only receipts; assess DB-05, ACC-01/02, and OPS-01 against the final changed boundaries.

## Implementation and boundaries

Current schemas have bounded proposed/approval/queued/running/succeeded/failed/cancelled/expired states, request/receipt contracts, and a service RPC for approval, but no general execution consumer was found in the readback. The existing `ai-execute/execution-policy.ts` only allowlists `review_prompt_promotion`; `approval-decide` authenticates the locked account, requires AAL2, and calls `decide_approval()`. The approvals page currently handles approve/reject and MFA, without the full request/receipt/reversal lifecycle. Trace producers/callers and existing DB constraints must be followed before choosing the smallest implementation boundary. Keep the policy deterministic and independent of free-text content; hard-deny transactions, investments, purchases, and unsupported outreach before side effects. Preserve existing authentication, RLS, spending, action-approval, and worker command boundaries. Do not implement Gmail transport or modify unrelated shell, Career, Procurement, or worker areas.

## Local tests and commands

After the shared QA slot is released and `corepack pnpm qa:doctor --fix` passes, start with the narrow tests beside `packages/contracts/src/execution.ts`, the affected Edge policy/execution handlers, and any directly changed UI; add SQL lifecycle/idempotency/owner-boundary coverage only if persistence changes. Include regression proofs for verified command authority versus proposal approval, prohibited-action deny-before-effect, current-state preconditions, replay idempotency, truthful partial failure, and supported reversal receipt. Then run `corepack pnpm verify:changed` before opening the PR. Initial readback proof: `node infrastructure/scripts/ticket-readback.mjs check AI-44`.

## Hosted proof and readiness

The issue requires a bounded staging pass: read-only use causes no action; a website action with stale MFA is blocked and fresh reauthentication permits exactly one effect and receipt; the verified-channel fixture adds no content classifier or second approval; low-risk preauthorized work records policy/audit; prohibited actions stop before side effect; replay is idempotent; partial failure is truthful; and supported reversal creates its receipt. This web reauthentication boundary cannot be established by local tests. Use the existing staging/release candidate gates and a headed browser; when it is ready for the required manual MFA step, pause and ask the user. No staging action has been run or proven yet.
